svg.title: The Holy Earth Foundation. Plants & Miracles.
svg.desc: The foundation's mark inside a breathing Golden Halo whose rays slowly turn, in a forest before dawn warming into the light. Fireflies drift, and the Vine of the Soul, a twin-stranded liana of sky and gold with paired leaves and small pink-white blossoms, sways toward the halo. I am one Self, united with my Creator.
